permissionsHelp.title: Permissions & Setup
permissionsHelp.intro: POWR needs a few permissions to earn for you automatically. Here's what each one does and how to fix it if it's switched off.

location.title: Location
location.whyGym: Detects when you arrive at a partner gym and earns points at geofenced venues — even while POWR is closed.
location.whyVenue: Detects when you arrive at a partner venue and earns points at geofenced venues — even while POWR is closed.

ios.step1: Tap Open Settings below to jump to POWR's settings

android.step1: Tap Open Settings below to open POWR's app info

location.noteIosGym: Location is on, but not set to "Always" — POWR can't detect gym arrivals when it's closed. If you don't see "Always" yet, choose "While Using the App" first, then come back.
location.noteIosVenue: Location is on, but not set to "Always" — POWR can't detect venue arrivals when it's closed. If you don't see "Always" yet, choose "While Using the App" first, then come back.
location.noteAndroidGym: Location is on, but not "Allow all the time" — POWR can't detect gym arrivals when it's closed.
location.noteAndroidVenue: Location is on, but not "Allow all the time" — POWR can't detect venue arrivals when it's closed.

battery.title: Background activity
battery.whyGym: Lets POWR keep detecting gym arrivals when the app is fully closed. Without it, Android can sleep the app and miss check-ins.
battery.whyVenue: Lets POWR keep detecting venue arrivals when the app is fully closed. Without it, Android can sleep the app and miss check-ins.
battery.step2: Allow POWR to ignore battery optimisation
battery.step3: Or set Battery to "Unrestricted" on POWR's app page

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.whyGym: Confirms gym check-ins, tells you when points land, and alerts you to rewards you can claim.
notifications.whyVenue: Confirms sessions, tells you when points land, and alerts you to rewards you can claim.

health.why: Reads your steps, workouts and sleep so they can be verified and turned into points — no wearable required.

ios.step2: Tap your profile photo (top-right), then Privacy › Apps
ios.step3: Tap POWR and turn on the categories you want to share

android.step3: Allow read access for Steps, Workouts and Sleep

permissionsHelp.footer: Changed a setting? Return here and the status above will update. Still stuck? Use the Help Centre to contact us.
